title: Rust gateway DAO route mutation trusts caller-asserted sender IID without link evidence
description: Security review P1. RplStack::complete_dao_from_frame is a public state-mutating API that accepts raw compressed bytes plus a caller-supplied sender_iid, not an AuthenticatedFrame/capability. It passes that assertion into DAO sender authorization and route installation. rust/lichen-gateway/src/gateway.rs process_rpl extracts the IID from the unauthenticated decompressed IPv6 source and invokes both handle_border_control_frame and complete_dao_from_frame, so raw SLIP input can choose immediate-sender authority. Require owner-issued current link-authenticated evidence (signature, replay, destination, key generation) for production DAO handling; keep raw parsing test-only; add a test that a signed origin DAO relayed through an unauthenticated/forged immediate sender cannot mutate routes.
